hero: Write down what this year taught you while you can still remember.
sub: One page is enough: the job you would take again, the one you would not, and the client who always paid on time. Next year gets built on that page, not on memory.

hero: Hand us the filing calendar and it becomes our job, not yours.
sub: We put the dates in our own diary and work back from them, so the paperwork comes to you early instead of at the last minute. First 30 minutes free.

hero: Ask us what your numbers mean and you get an answer, not a lecture.
sub: We sit down and go through them with you: what came in, what went out, and what is actually yours to keep. Bring a figure you were never sure of. First 30 minutes free.

setup: I asked a client how the year had gone.
punch: He said busy. Then he went quiet.
hook: Busy and profitable are not the same thing, and only one of them is still there in January.

line: Great works are performed not by strength but by perseverance.
